title: Special Executive Programme In Global Business Enterprises
description: This special executive course aims to equip professionals with a comprehensive understanding of global business strategies, providing the knowledge and skills necessary to excel in the international business landscape.
longDescription: This special executive program in Global Business Enterprises offers a comprehensive overview of the global business landscape, examining the impact of globalization and economic development on businesses. Participants will explore the key features of global business, its advantages, challenges, and the complexities of operating on an international scale. The course covers the role of multinational enterprises, their entry strategies, and the significance of economic blocs on business operations. Additionally, it addresses managing international risk, understanding foreign markets, and navigating government regulations, cross-border transactions, and cultural influences, with a focus on ethical considerations and corporate social responsibility in international business.

The programme on "Global Business Enterprises" provides an in-depth understanding of globalization and its impact on businesses, covering key aspects such as global business features, challenges, and new trade theory. Participants will explore the role of multinational companies, their growth, entry strategies, and impact on host countries, alongside an analysis of economic blocs like the EU and NAFTA. The course also addresses the influence of foreign markets, government regulations, cross-border transactions, and cultural factors, while emphasizing international ethics, corporate social responsibility, and risk management in the global business environment.
After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following;
Nature of Multinational Enterprises And Their Role In Globalisation:
Basic Reasons for Creating Economic Blocks and Consequences of this Development:
Business of Foreign Markets And Their Impact on Business Decisions:
Role of Government, Cross Border Transactions, Cultural And Regional Influences:
